scope: Peru medical discovery — National University of San Marcos Faculty of Medicine

verifiedFacts.claim: UNMSM's Faculty of Medicine describes its Escuela Profesional de Medicina Humana and publishes its 2024 plan of studies, totaling 350 credits and 10,080 semester hours.
UNMSM's current admissions page schedules the 2026-II Medicina Humana entrance examination for 15 March 2026.
SUNEDU lists UNMSM's Lima undergraduate medicine programme as licensed.
A 2026 Faculty of Medicine agreement with Hospital María Auxiliadora covers undergraduate training and internado in Medicina Humana.
